data.case_title: Reha application rejected by Rentenversicherung Musterhessen-Lahn
data.explanation: This is a decision (Bescheid) from the German pension insurance (Rentenversicherung) refusing your request for inpatient medical rehabilitation. They judge that the outpatient physiotherapy your orthopaedist already prescribed is sufficient and that your ability to work is not significantly at risk. You may file a written objection (Widerspruch) if you disagree with this assessment; the app shows until when you can do this. If your symptoms get worse later, you can submit a new application at any time, independent of this decision. Consider asking your doctor or a social-law advisor for help if you want to contest the medical assessment.
